"""Run max-scale inputs under the real child restrictions (seccomp + rlimits)."""
import importlib.util, json, os, resource, selectors, signal, subprocess, sys, time
BASE = '/workspace'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('guard', BASE + '/child_guard.py')
guard = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(guard)
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import job, req
import itertools

NAMES = [chr(ord('a') + i).upper() for i in range(16)]
SVC = [{"name": n, "label": i + 1} for i, n in enumerate(NAMES)]
LIM = {"images": 16, "cells": 262144, "units": 1024, "contexts": 32768,
       "connections": 4096, "packets": 32768, "files": 8192}
U32 = 4294967295

def run_guarded(data):
    env = dict(PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/workspace', LANG='C',
               LC_ALL='C', TMPDIR='/workspace/tmp', PYTHONHASHSEED='0',
               PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1',
               OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1', MKL_NUM_THREADS='1')
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', BASE + '/launch.py', BASE + '/project'],
                         stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                         env=env, cwd='/workspace', preexec_fn=guard.restrict, close_fds=True)
    out = bytearray()
    err = bytearray()
    os.set_blocking(p.stdin.fileno(), False)
    os.set_blocking(p.stdout.fileno(), False)
    os.set_blocking(p.stderr.fileno(), False)
    sel = selectors.DefaultSelector()
    sel.register(p.stdin, selectors.EVENT_WRITE)
    sel.register(p.stdout, selectors.EVENT_READ)
    sel.register(p.stderr, selectors.EVENT_READ)
    off = 0
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    while sel.get_map():
        assert time.monotonic() - t0 < 170, "timeout"
        for key, _ in sel.select(0.1):
            if key.fileobj is p.stdin:
                try:
                    off += os.write(p.stdin.fileno(), data[off:off + 65536])
                except BlockingIOError:
                    pass
                if off >= len(data):
                    sel.unregister(p.stdin)
                    p.stdin.close()
            elif key.fileobj is p.stdout:
                try:
                    b = os.read(p.stdout.fileno(), 65536)
                except BlockingIOError:
                    continue
                if not b:
                    sel.unregister(p.stdout)
                else:
                    out.extend(b)
            else:
                try:
                    b = os.read(p.stderr.fileno(), 65536)
                except BlockingIOError:
                    continue
                if not b:
                    sel.unregister(p.stderr)
                else:
                    err.extend(b)
    rc = p.wait(timeout=30)
    rss = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss // 1024
    return rc, bytes(out), bytes(err), rss

# max inspect output scenario

raw = json.dumps({"jobs": [{"services": SVC, "limits": LIM, "events": events}]}).encode()
rc, out, err, rss = run_guarded(raw)

assert rc == 0 and not err
r = json.loads(out)
